name: a glitching category word cuts through client proof
looks: A huge category word glitches and flickers across a solid colour card, a row of small client names beneath it; hard cuts take it to a moody portrait with floating data callouts, then to a client's logo centred on a soft gradient card, each full-bleed and on the beat.
build: kinetic-word-run: the glitching word uses noise-dissolve-logomark's seeded-point jitter on the letterforms instead of a clean reveal; the portrait and logo cards are hard DOM swaps with no crossfade, the HUD frame's corner brackets and timecode running the whole time.
sound: A glitch texture under the word, a hit on each hard cut.
prompt: Open on a huge category word that glitches and flickers on a bold colour card, with a short row of client names beneath it. Hard-cut through a moody portrait carrying a couple of small floating data callouts, then to a single client logo on a soft gradient card, each cut landing on the beat with a HUD frame running throughout.
